review_evidence: README describes kcompile-driven C code generation for Lean functions; KArray/Kernel.lean defines Kernel, KBuffer, KTFun, KExpr and related reflected type/function interfaces.
The reviewed 10 Lean files contain about 70 declaration-shaped items; test/Test.lean and examples/KArrayExample/Main.lean exercise the user-facing compilation contracts.
No generated subtree or duplicate copy of canonical declarations is present in the manifest.
summary: Retain lean4-karray: the unit is a small typed code-generation/interface library whose examples and test file expose the intended reflected-kernel API rather than a redundant generated corpus.
